one_line: Film one slow pan in a styled corner with a big title, 7 s, solo with a phone.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 handheld close view of a children's room corner: a beige foam rainbow arch, a basket of soft toys, a green rug. The English title "the Rainbow Gymboree" is still animating in. No speech, no Hebrew text.
q1_hook.why: A calm, pleasant picture with a product name, but no problem, question, face or promise, and the title is English and half drawn (H1, H7, T3). Nothing tells a Hebrew-speaking parent what the item does (H2), and no voice is heard (H4).

beats.what: Corner of the room: foam arch, basket of soft toys, green rug; the title animates in
beats.why: Sets a calm mood and names the item

beats.what: The pan rises along a plaid wall past a child's drawing, arches below; "INTERIOR DESIGN STUDIO" appears
beats.why: A new view of the room, the product partly out of frame

beats.what: Plaid wall, a bed and a side table with a mushroom lamp; the arch is almost gone
beats.why: A decor shot, with the product leaving the frame

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption is a statement with a brand tag, no question, nothing to save or send.
q2_flow.why: A single 7 s pan fits the length for one visual moment (R2) and wastes nothing (R1), but there is no character, turn or payoff (K2), the product has nearly left the frame by 0:06, and the end does not lead back to the start (R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: no voice, no ask, no link or code. The caption has only the tag @bliss.il.
q3_cta.why: An interested viewer has no next step except the tag (C6). The sell is as light as it can be, the brand is not named in the video (C7), but the Reel cannot lead anywhere.

q4_shown.what: Beige, cream and brown foam rainbow arches in a corner 0:00-0:05, partly under the title; a basket of soft toys and a rug 0:00-0:02; plaid wallpaper and a drawing 0:03; a bed and a lamp 0:06. No child, hands, use or price.
q4_shown.why: The arches are never touched or used (S1, S4), and the room, not the product, is what is shown (K5). With no use and no Hebrew explanation, the value is unclear (H2).

q5_edit.what: One shot of 7.2 s: a continuous slow handheld pan, no cuts, no speed changes. The title is fixed over the whole Reel and animates in during the first 2 s. No voice. It ends on the plaid wall and the bed.
q5_edit.why: Live movement from the first frame (E1, F8), but the audio is not established and there is no Hebrew text, so a muted viewer gets nothing (E4). It ends on a decor shot with the product out of frame (E8).

q6_topic.what: A styled children's room corner with a foam rainbow arch set, shown as decor. Serves parents who care about how a child's room looks.
q6_topic.why: The mood is calm and aesthetic, not the high-arousal moment that gets sent on (K1, R5). No parenting concern, occasion or story is named, so nothing in the list explains who would save it.

q7_filmed.what: A slow handheld upward and sideways pan from a low angle in a styled room: foam arches in a corner, a rug, a basket of toys, plaid wallpaper, a bed.
q7_filmed.why: Vertical, soft-lit and steady enough (F1, F7), but the polished interior-studio look and title read as an ad, not a creator clip (H8). The product is cut by the frame edge and covered by the title at 0:00 to 0:02 (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: "the Rainbow Gymboree" in large white English serif, centred from about 33% to 60% of the frame height, on screen for all 7 s and animating in over the first 2 s. "INTERIOR DESIGN STUDIO" in tiny spaced capitals at about 70% from 0:02. No Hebrew anywhere.
q8_text.caption: "חדר ילדים נעים לא צריך הרבה…". Three short lines, about 11 words: a sentence, "רק את הפרטים הנכונים." and the tag @bliss.il. No hashtags, CTA or disclosure words.
q8_text.why: A title card at 0:00 names the topic (T3) but in English, not a Hebrew promise (T6). It covers the middle of the frame and the product for the whole Reel (T2), and the small line is unreadable on a phone (T5). The caption has no product keyword, hashtags (T7) or disclosure (T8).

weak_points: No child, hands, use or story; an English-only title covering the product for the whole Reel; a tiny unreadable studio line; no CTA; the product leaves the frame by 0:06; no hashtags or disclosure words.
lumebook_takeaway: Film one slow 7 s pan of the book standing in a styled corner, but add a Hebrew title, hands opening it once, and one ask.
not_verified: Whether music plays: the transcript's only line is a hallucination, so there is no speech, but no sound label is visible. Whether the studio built the room. Correction to src/coded: the title is half drawn for the first 1 to 2 s, and the arch is almost out of frame by 0:06.
